mechanism: Risedronate may impair dronedarone absorption due to its effect on gastric pH and potential for esophageal irritation; dronedarone is a CYP3A4 inhibitor which may affect risedronate metabolism minimally but bidirectional effects on GI absorption are clinically relevant.
action: Separate administration by at least 30 minutes; ensure adequate hydration and upright posture with risedronate; monitor for reduced dronedarone efficacy and increased GI adverse effects.
